title: Restaurant in Rockville, Maryland
assumptions: The company still has to be formed (an LLC) unless an entity is named. Hires staff. Builds out the space. No new exterior sign (signage: false).

items.name: Articles of Organization (Maryland LLC)
items.agency: Maryland Department of Assessments and Taxation
items.quote: The person(s) signing below is(are) duly authorized to file this Articles of Organization

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Sales and use tax license (Combined Registration Application)
items.match: sales and use tax|sales tax|combined registration|md-cra
items.quote: This is required if you sell items in Maryland and collect sales tax.

items.name: Unemployment insurance account
items.agencyMatch: maryland department of labor|comptroller of maryland
items.quote: You must apply for an unemployment insurance account through the Maryland Department of Labor if you are:

items.name: Food service plan review
items.agency: Montgomery County Department of Health and Human Services, Licensure and Regulatory Services
items.match: (plan (check|review)).*(montgomery county|health and human services)|(montgomery county|health and human services).*(plan (check|review))
items.quote: Future code violations are prevented by addressing any potential layout & design concerns prior to construction or renovation beginning.

items.name: Food service facility license
items.agency: Montgomery County Department of Health and Human Services, Licensure and Regulatory Services
items.match: (food service facility license|food (service )?license|food establishment license).*(montgomery county|health and human services)|(montgomery county|health and human services).*(food service facility license|food (service )?license|food establishment license)
items.quote: A license must be obtained prior to opening a business.

items.name: Certified food service manager
items.agency: Montgomery County Department of Health and Human Services
items.match: (certified food (service|safety|protection) manager|food (service )?manager).*(montgomery county|health and human services|health)|(montgomery county|health and human services|health).*(certified food (service|safety|protection) manager|food (service )?manager)
items.quote: a licensee must not operate a food service facility unless the facility is under the immediate control of a Certified Food Service Manager.

items.name: Trader's license
items.agency: Clerk of the Circuit Court (Montgomery County)
items.match: (trader'?s license).*(clerk of the circuit court)|(clerk of the circuit court).*(trader'?s license)
items.quote: you may not offer for sale, sell or otherwise dispose of any goods within Maryland, without first obtaining a trader's license from the Clerk of the Circuit Court
items.condition: The county's food license page: "Many businesses also are required to have a Trader's License." A restaurant should check with the Circuit Court.

items.name: Building permit for the build-out
items.quote: Commercial and residential properties in the City of Rockville are required to obtain permits before starting construction projects

items.name: Commercial occupancy permit
items.match: (occupancy permit|use and occupancy|certificate of occupancy).*(rockville)|(rockville).*(occupancy permit|use and occupancy|certificate of occupancy)

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
items.note: Added in the coverage audit of 2026-10-22: bought from an insurer once there is staff.
items.quote: every employer in the State of Maryland with one or more employees is required by law to provide workers’ compensation coverage

order.why: IRS: "form your entity through the secretary of state before you apply for an EIN."
Plan review before construction; the license before opening.

mustNotInclude.name: Montgomery County DPS permits
mustNotInclude.why: Rockville issues its own building and occupancy permits.
